content:
Mira: Heads up — finance flagged duplicated token counts on a couple of Feb invoices
Jonathan: Which customers?
Mira: acme-health and betaLabs, invoice INV-2026-0173 (link) and INV-2026-0199. Both show ~2x tokens compared to our usage dashboard.
Sasha: I think this lines up with the canary we rolled last week that enabled shadow metering in the router change.
Mira: Yup, I traced events — we have both live + shadow events flowing into the metering topic.
Sasha: My intent was only for observability, not billing. The logging looked like this: 
```
2026-02-28T14:02:11Z INFO router request_id=abcd1234 customer=acme branch=canary metering=emit,shadow
2026-02-28T14:02:11Z INFO metering-proxy event=token_event customer=acme tokens=124 path=/v1/streams
```
Kevin: Oof. Shadow should never be billed. Where did the config come from?
Sasha: PR #451 added a small flag to router: 
```
metering:
  mode: emit
  shadow: true
```
Arjun: Who approved that PR?
Sasha: I merged it for quick visibility, missed the billing downstreams. My bad.
billing-bot: @sasha automated-reconciler detected 2 invoices with +100% token counts and created ticket FIN-423
Mira: Priority: stop further double-counting, identify impacted customers, and plan corrective invoices. Quick options: revert the PR or patch router to suppress shadow emissions.
Jonathan: Also need a telemetry flag so metering events explicitly mark `billing_source` or `billing_tags:["shadow"]` so pipeline can dedupe safely.
Mira: Short-term: suppress shadow emissions. Medium-term: producer schema change + pipeline dedupe+console UX.
Kevin: Be careful with dedupe heuristics — if we dedupe by token count alone we might drop legitimate retries. We need event_id + customer dedupe.
Arjun: Agree. I can sketch dedupe logic: prefer events where `billing_tags` does not include `shadow`. If missing, fallback to event_id dedupe window of 2m.
Sasha: I'll open a revert PR now and follow with a patch that flips `metering.shadow=false` on canary nodes.
Mira: Also loop in finance support and CS for affected customers. We need a reissue plan and clear comms.
billing-bot: FIN-423 created and assigned to finance-support team; linked to tech ticket ENG-824
Jonathan: For the long-term UX: Console rollout page should show a per-rollout toggle: 
- Shadow: telemetry only
- Emit: emit to metering pipeline
And a warning banner if you try to enable emit during a canary.
Sasha: Revert PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/459 opened. Patch rolling to canary nodes (eta ~15m).
Kevin: Adding simple unit: `assert(!metering_event.billing_tags.contains("shadow"))` in router tests.
Arjun: I'll run reconciliation post-patch and report deltas. If we see >1% delta across customers, escalate.
Mira: Thanks. After patch, we'll run a small backfill/dedupe job for the window since the canary started and prepare refund calculations.
Sasha: Sorry folks — will follow up with postmortem + RFC for producer schema and console controls.
Mira: Appreciate it. Please @mention finance when you have the delta numbers. :heart:
thread_summary: Canary enabled shadow metering and accidentally emitted billing events causing duplicate token counts. Team coordinating revert/patch, dedupe heuristics, producer schema change, and finance notification.
